relationships.subject: TAK-242
relationships.evidence_quote: pharmacological inhibition of either the spinal TLR4 receptor (Tak-242) or the NLRP3 inflammasome (MCC950) reverses established morphine-induced prolonged allodynia in nerve-injured male PAE mice

key_findings: Spinal TLR4 (TAK-242) or NLRP3 (MCC950) blockade reverses morphine-prolonged allodynia in nerve-injured PAE mice.
MCC950 reduces spinal IL-1β, caspase-1, HMGB1 and astrocyte activation.
